title: Agentic Freelance: Is it real? Plain answers
description: Four plain answers (OpenClaw, TaskMarket, Superteam Earn, Algora), each with dated numbers, what was not verified and the next-best route with its odds. Built only from run 8 numbers (7 October 2026).
usage_rules: Expected values are estimates, never promises.
public_file names the published data file that holds a number; source_note marks numbers kept only in the run working files and repeated in the report.
rule: Every number comes from a run file named in source_path; nothing new is asserted here. Expected values are estimates, never promises.

answers.question: Does OpenClaw make money?
answers.one_line: No by itself: OpenClaw is a self-hosted assistant with no built-in earning, payment or marketplace feature; it can only earn by being pointed at a venue that pays, and it costs tokens while idle.

answers.what_we_did_not_verify: No dollar figure for idle cost exists in first-party docs (secondary guides range from about $0.72/day to $150/month); nothing was installed or run; third-party payment skills were not reviewed.

next_best_route.odds_line: Superteam agent-allowed: p_win 0.027 per entry, about 0.088 eligible listings a day, about $0.24 expected per day at any cap, median first cash about 301 days; payment not verifiable

answers.question: Is TaskMarket real? Does it pay?
answers.one_line: Yes, it pays on chain, but small and not reliably: about 1 in 74 entries wins about $1.85, and about 1 in 5 submissions went to tasks that paid nobody; "funded" means locked, not "will be paid".

answers.question: Is Superteam Earn legit for agents?
answers.one_line: Partly: the board is real and lists agent-allowed bounties, and agent accounts have won, but we could not see a single payment on public routes and none of the 10 agent wins has been claimed.

answers.what_we_did_not_verify: Whether any winner was paid (payment fields are sign-in only); whether claimed agent wins are paid; why agent accounts won on two listings that are human-only today; KYC form length.

next_best_route.why: payments are visible on chain, though the expected value per attempt is below mid-tier token cost
next_best_route.odds_line: TaskMarket: p_win_final 0.0136, about $0.08 back per $1 at mid tier, about $0.08 expected per day at $1.50, median first cash about 17 days; payments verifiable on chain

answers.question: Does Algora pay for agent-drafted work?
answers.one_line: It has paid, but not lately, and we cannot tell whether any paid PR was agent-drafted: 6 boards paid 27 awards in 180 days, none since 2026-07-02, and about 2 open bounties remain.

answers.what_we_did_not_verify: Whether Algora moved bounties off GitHub (challenges pages not read); whether two onboarding-pending awards were paid; Stripe Connect field count; agent use behind any winning PR.
